test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is known as the steel city in India?
solution:
The correct answer is Jamshedpur.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jamshedpur** is often referred to as the **"Steel City of India"**. It is located in the** East Singhbhum district of Jharkhand**.
 
• This Industrial city was founded by the visionary **Jamshedji Tata in 1907**, the **founder of the Tata Group**.
 
• This city was originally known as **Sakchi,** but it was renamed Jamshedpur in **1919 by Lord Chelmsford**.
 
• Jamshedpur is considered **India's first planned Industrial City**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jamshedpur city is managed by **Tata Steel's Jamshedpur Utilities and Services Company(JUSCO)**.
 
• **Adityapur Industrial Area** near Jamshedpur is** one of Asia's largest Industrial Areas**.
 
• Mumbai is known as the** Financial Capital of India**.
 
• **Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus(CST) **is the** busiest** Railway Station in Mumbai.
 
• **Patna** is the** capital of** State **Bihar**.
 
• Patna was **historically known as Patliputra**. The Famous historical park Gandhi Maidan is in Patna.
 
• **Lok Nayak Jayaprapaksh Airport** is in Patna, Bihar
 
• Ranchi is the** Capital of** the State of **Jharkhand**. Famous Cricketer **M.S. Dhoni **hails from Ranchi.
 
• Ranchi is famous for **Uranium Resources**.** Hindi is the official Language** of Ranchi.
 
• Ranchi's climate is **tropical wet, and dry**. And Ranchi is a part of **Chota Nagpur Plateau**.
